metadata.notes: First baseline for sift-email (issue #109). Evals 1-18, two runs each, with run-mcp-trials.sh against the Gmail, Claude Docs, and Contacts stubs, on SKILL.md as committed with this baseline. Run date 2026-10-11 (fixtures anchored to 2026-10-10, shift 0). Failures: eval 1 (both runs) left the new doc links out of the log summary, though the chat reply has them; eval 15 consolidated to 12 rules, each naming only its own senders, against an expectation of fewer than 10 lines (the expectation is stricter than the skill's no-broadening rule allows), and run 1 did not log the consolidation in the changelog. The Docs stub's batch was not yet atomic when these trials ran (fixed in the same change); one refused batch (eval 2 run 2) kept its earlier members, and the retry left the same final state.
